import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Filter out derived features for driver selection
    non_derived_ids = [fid for fid, typ in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if typ != 'derived']
    non_derived_indices = [feats.column(fid) for fid in non_derived_ids]
    
    # Calculate effect sizes using t-statistics
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(non_derived_ids):
        col_idx = non_derived_indices[i]
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        mean1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        mean0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        diff = mean1 - mean0
        
        # Welch's t-test
        group1 = x[y == 1]
        group0 = x[y == 0]
        n1, n0 = len(group1), len(group0)
        var1, var0 = np.var(group1), np.var(group0)
        se = np.sqrt(var1/n1 + var0/n0)
        t_stat = diff / se if se > 0 else 0
        
        effect_sizes.append((fid, abs(t_stat), diff))
    
    # Sort by effect size (t-statistic magnitude)
    effect_sizes.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top candidates, removing near-duplicates
    drivers = []
    used_ids = set()
    for fid, _, _ in effect_sizes:
        if len(drivers) >= MAX_DRIVERS:
            break
            
        # Check correlation with already selected drivers
        is_duplicate = False
        for selected_fid in drivers:
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(selected_fid)], 
                               feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
                
        if not is_duplicate and fid not in used_ids:
            drivers.append(fid)
            used_ids.add(fid)
    
    # Build columns list (include all non-derived features)
    columns = tuple(non_derived_ids)
    
    # Check for interaction terms among top drivers
    products = []
    if len(drivers) >= 2:
        # Add interaction between first two drivers if they're different
        if drivers[0] != drivers[1]:
            products.append((drivers[0], drivers[1]))
    
    # Compute weighted score using top driver
    loadings = {}
    if drivers:
        loadings[drivers[0]] = 1.0
    
    # Ensure we don't exceed maximum design terms
    total_terms = len(columns) + len(products) + len(loadings)
    if total_terms > 12:
        # Simplify: keep only drivers and their interactions
        columns = drivers
        products = tuple(p for p in products if p[0] in drivers and p[1] in drivers)
        loadings = {k: v for k, v in loadings.items() if k in drivers}
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=columns,
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
